chunks.page_content: Victoria was also known as Nao "Victoria". Victoria was a Spanish carrack. Victoria was given to Ferdinand Magellan by King Charles I of Spain. Victoria was an 85 ton ship. Victoria had a crew of 42. Victoria returned on September 6, 1522. Victoria was named after the church of Santa Maria de la Victoria de Triana. Ferdinand Magellan was killed in the Philippines. Ferdinand Magellan took an oath of allegiance to Charles V at the church of Santa Maria de la Victoria de Triana. Victoria was the only ship to complete the voyage. The Basques were reputed shipbuilders at the time Victoria was built. The Spanish expedition was commanded by Juan Sebastián Elcano after the death of Ferdinand Magellan during the voyage. Victoria was the first ship to successfully circumnavigate the world. Four other ships were given to Ferdinand Magellan by King Charles I of Spain along with Victoria. Victoria was part of a Spanish expedition. The expedition began on August 10, 1519.
